name: Arario Museum in Space
known: Founded by the collector and businessman Kim Chang-il, who also makes art as "CI Kim".
The museum site presents it as a private museum built on the founder's collection, with a greeting signed by Kim Chang-il as chairman of Arario Co. (stated by the museum).
Founder-funder Kim Chang-il got a 2-year sentence for breach of duty (Daejeon court, Feb 2021); the group said it would appeal.

name: Art Sonje Center
known: Founded and chaired by Heeja K.
The Daewoo Foundation page on artsonje.org says the foundation's projects "have been primarily funded by the late Daewoo Group chairperson Kim Woo Choong since 1978".
Chung married Kim in 1964; he died in 2019 (artsonje.org, Founder page).
Its parent is the Art Sonje Museum in Gyeongju, founded in 1991 by the same founder.
Private non-profit contemporary kunsthalle in Seoul founded by Chung Hee-ja.

name: National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art (MMCA)
known: South Korea's national museum of modern and contemporary Korean art, with four sites: Gwacheon, Deoksugung, Seoul (next to Gyeongbokgung) and Cheongju (a storage and conservation centre) (Wikipedia).
It is a state museum under the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, which removed one director in 2014 and accepted another's resignation in 2023 (Korea JoongAng Daily;

name: SONGEUN
known: Samtan was founded by Yoo Sung-yeon; the foundation was set up in 1989 to return his business wealth to society, and Yoo Sang-deok, then Samtan chairman, chaired the foundation (Energy Economy Newspaper, 2011).
Partners with the Delfina Foundation on residencies and with the Stedelijk Museum on a video series; its artistic director sits on the Gwangju Biennale board.
Founder's company is a coal miner and trader.

name: Seoul Museum of Art
known: The chair is Ko Kyung-mo, chief executive of Eugene Investment & Securities.

Directors listed include Kim Jung-tae (former chairman of Hana Financial Group), Yun Jong-ha (vice chairman of MBK Partners), Seo Jin-woo (vice chairman, SK China), Yun Won-ki (vice president of IMM Investment), Park Jung-min (former chief executive of SK Stoa), Seo Jung-ho (chairman of Ambassador H
Its patrons' page names the SeMA人[in] directors, including Hana Financial and MBK Partners executives, undated.

name: Whanki Museum
known: Founded by Kim Hyang-an (1916 to 2004), the widow of the painter Kim Whanki, who established the Whanki Foundation after his death and built the museum (Munhwa Ilbo, 5 September 2016).
Korea JoongAng Daily (25 June 2026) names the museum director as Park Mee-jung and the foundation president as Jang Jae-ryong.

name: Fundació Antoni Tàpies
known: Named for its founder.
Ferran Rodés and director Imma Prieto announced it (Bonart, 2 July 2024).
Governance: the board is chaired by Ferran Rodés i Vilà, with Teresa Barba Fàbregas as vice-president.

name: Fundació Joan Miró
known: Maribel López Zambrana, director of ARCOmadrid, was appointed director on 30 June 2026, succeeding Marko Daniel.
The board of up to 25 trustees is chaired by Sara Puig Alsina.
The director was paid €122,725 in 2025 (transparency portal).

name: La Pedrera (Casa Milà)
known: Director Marta Lacambra calls visits the main income source and says about 90% of visitors are international (New Barcelona Post).

Trustees in 2025 include Fundació RACC (chair Germán Ramón-Cortés Montaner), Fundació Víctor Grífols i Lucas, Fundació Carulla, Fundació ACE, Fundació Universitària del Bages and representatives of the Diputació de Tarragona and the Diputació de Barcelona (annual report 2025).

name: La Virreina Centre de la Imatge
known: Its director Valentín Roma was appointed director of the MACBA unanimously by the general council of the museum consortium on 10 June 2026.
He is to start there in the coming weeks (Ara, Antoni Ribas Tur, 10 June 2026, "Valentín Roma es el nuevo director del Macba").
Directed by writer and curator Valentín Roma.
